mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sekai_song_user(user_name, password, nick_name, avatar_url, license_plan, license_expire_time, license_code) VALUES (#{userName}, #{password}, #{nickName}, #{avatarUrl}, #{licensePlan}, #{licenseExpireTime}, #{licenseCode})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sekai_song_user WHERE user_name = #{userName} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM sekai_song_user WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sekai_song_user SET license_plan = #{licensePlan}, license_expire_time = #{licenseExpireTime}, license_code = #{licenseCode}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
